name_zh: 加拿大·路易·里尔：梅蒂斯叛乱与少数权利曼尼托巴建省
name_en: Canada Louis Riel: Metis Rebellion & Minority Rights Manitoba Province
description_zh: 路易·里尔 (1844-1885) 梅蒂斯领袖，1869红河起义建立曼尼托巴省保障梅蒂斯权利，1885西北起义失败被绞刑，原住民混血权利斗争象征，1992年被加拿大承认建国之父。
description_en: Louis Riel (1844-1885) Metis leader, 1869 Red River Rebellion established Manitoba Province guaranteeing Metis rights, 1885 Northwest Rebellion failed executed, indigenous mixed-race rights struggle symbol, 1992 recognized as Canadian Father of Confederation.
reason_zh: 里尔代表混血原住民如何通过武装起义争取法律权利与省份地位，展示了加拿大联邦制如何通过梅蒂斯斗争被迫纳入少数族群保护，其悲剧英雄形象重塑加拿大建国神话。
reason_en: Riel represents how mixed-race indigenous people seized legal rights and provincial status through armed rebellion, demonstrating how Canadian federalism was forced to incorporate minority protections through Metis struggle, his tragic hero image reshaping Canadian founding mythology.
steps_zh: 研究里尔早年蒙特利尔神学院教育与红河定居点
分析1869红河起义与曼尼托巴法案梅蒂斯权利条款
探讨1885西北起义与加拿大太平洋铁路军事镇压
评估1885年里贾纳绞刑与梅蒂斯土地权利丧失
总结梅蒂斯叛乱路易里尔曼尼托巴少数权利对加拿大联邦制的奠基重塑
steps_en: Study Riel early Montreal seminary education and Red River settlement
Analyze 1869 Red River Rebellion and Manitoba Act Metis rights clauses
Explore 1885 Northwest Rebellion and CPR military suppression
Evaluate 1885 Regina execution and Metis land rights loss
Summarize Metis rebellion Louis Riel Manitoba minority rights foundational reshaping of Canadian federalism
expected_zh: 掌握混血原住民武装斗争如何迫使联邦制纳入少数权利保护，理解里尔悲剧如何从叛徒重构为建国之父的历史翻案，评估梅蒂斯模式对魁北克原住民自治诉求的示范。
expected_en: Master how mixed-race indigenous armed struggle forced federalism to incorporate minority rights protection, grasp Riel tragedy historical revision from traitor to founding father, evaluate Metis model demonstration for Quebec indigenous autonomy claims.
case_zh: 1869 红河起义；1870 曼尼托巴省；1885 西北起义绞刑；1992 承认建国之父。梅蒂斯叛乱少数权利范式永存。
case_en: 1869 Red River Rebellion; 1970 Manitoba Province; 1885 Northwest Rebellion execution; 1992 recognized founding father. Metis rebellion minority rights paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: Metis Nationalism / Canadian Federalism / Indigenous Rights
cross_cultural_impact: Metis rights; Manitoba founding; indigenous rebellion; Canadian confederation
